Row-Template ships **fifteen core templates**. Each is a complete design — its own
layout, its own typography, its own structure — and each is byte-locked, so a released
design cannot change without a deliberate, reviewed update.

Every template is available, every template is locked, and every template owns an
independent `layout.html`. There are no provisional designs.

## What every template shares

Whichever you choose, you get the same guarantees. These come from the shared runtime,
not from any individual design:

- **One self-contained artifact.** CSS, JavaScript, the fonts and the QR generator are
  all inlined. The page fetches nothing from anywhere.
- **The same runtime.** A template is a layout and a stylesheet set, never a fork of the
  logic.
- **The same data.** Status, traffic, expiry, configurations and clients are identical
  across all fifteen.
- **Right-to-left support**, and **dark and light themes**.
- **79 required hooks**, exactly three scripts, and a byte lock pinning the artifact to
  an exact size and SHA-256.
